lineage_reviews.original_input_review: Compared the 81-byte scenario action fingerprint with the action text and independently inspected all three 2026-09-23 requirement records and their digests in /home/tree/ai/Input.md.
lineage_reviews.mock_boundary_review: The post-fix evidence starts at original_input with mocked=false and substitutions=[]; the recorder reads real staged, installed, backup, AGENTS, removal, and archive filesystem state and runs the real quick validator and layout-validator self-tests.
lineage_reviews.loader_order_review: Inspected the evidence.json post-fix observation, its trace, loader capture, and recorder source; artifact order matches the staged SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, and validate_layout_contract.py hashes, and each downstream trace digest is derived from measured data rather than the contract's expected result.

findings.summary: The initial contract preserved only the skill-creation requirement and omitted the removal, active-configuration backup, and checksum completion requirements; the current contract records three distinct requirements and links all three to the acceptance scenario.

The initial recorder copied expected_result into intermediate lineage steps; the current recorder fingerprints actual staged bytes, validator subprocess results, and installed/backup/AGENTS/removal/archive filesystem state.
